messages.text: Cross-lane assumptions to confirm when phase 4-backend-backup lands: (1) the import response's `skipped` must be an object { companies: number, diagnoses: number } (src/api/backupApi.ts:22-25, BackupSection.tsx importSummary); (2) the server import size limit must be 10 MB, matching BACKUP_MAX_BYTES (src/api/backupApi.ts:6); (3) 422 backup_newer_version should carry details.rulesVersion (BackupSection.tsx newerVersionMessage); (4) export failures should answer 500 write_failed with a message.

To run the deferred checks: after phase 4-backend-backup and 4-integration-e2e-features exist, run `pnpm test -- tests/api/backupRoutes.test.ts` and `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/backup.spec.ts` in C:/dev/playapps/v-stage. Selectors: section [data-aioson-id=settings-backup]; buttons [data-aioson-id=backup-export] and [data-aioson-id=backup-import]; file input [data-aioson-id=backup-import-file] (setInputFiles, .json); results role=alert with data-aioson-id backup-export-saved, backup-export-error, backup-import-done, backup-import-error.
The frontend's httpClient already sends Content-Type application/json and a `{}` body for POST, so a body-less POST to /api/backup/export is not rejected with 415. No backend action needed for that.
